'''K4-E2''' was a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was sent to the [[Makeb orbital station|orbital station]] on [[Makeb]] as a courier by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Varnus Olec]] to help him enlist the services of the Imperial strike team regarding the build up of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Darvannis]].<ref name="TOR" />
